subject: Nightshift-friendly hybrid console + API onboarding — split or single session?
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Barnes <alex.barnes@lyticsys.com>, onboarding@lyticsys.com
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 12 Jun 2028 16:30:00 +0000
Subject: Nightshift-friendly hybrid console + API onboarding — split or single session?

Hi Alex / Lytic team,

Thanks again for choosing Redwood for your inference rollout. We want to make the onboarding practical for your APAC ops folks, so a couple quick questions before I lock a slot:

- Would you prefer a single 3-hour hybrid session (console walkthrough + an API hands-on lab) or two shorter sessions (1.5h console + 1.5h API) across two evenings?
- Do you have a preferred timezone window between 18:00–22:00 AEST on weekdays? We can also do a weekend slot if that helps your engineers.

Suggested dates we have available in the next two weeks (AEST):
- Wed 21 Jun, 18:30–21:30 AEST (single session)
- Thu 22 Jun, 19:00–20:30 AEST + Mon 26 Jun, 19:00–20:30 AEST (split sessions)

I've attached a short prework checklist and a mutual-action-plan so we can reduce day-of friction. Ben (SE) will run the API lab; I’ll cover the console walkthrough. Priyom — can you confirm access steps for the sandbox cluster (SSH keys / temporary creds)?

If those windows don't work, tell us your top 2 and we’ll aim to accommodate.

Best,

Marissa Cole
Enterprise Onboarding Lead
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Lytic_Onboarding_Prework.pdf (pdf, 1.2MB)]
[Attachment: Lytic_Mutual_Action_Plan.xlsx (xlsx, 85KB)]

From: Alex Barnes <alex.barnes@lyticsys.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: onboarding@lyticsys.com
Date: Tue, 12 Jun 2028 19:02:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Nightshift-friendly hybrid console + API onboarding — split or single session?

Hi Marissa,

Appreciate the options. Our primary engineering team is in Melbourne (AEST) and evenings there work best. A few notes:

- We prefer two shorter sessions if possible — the API engineers will need to run code against our staging stack the following day and a separated lab is easier for them.
- Thu 22 Jun for the console, and Mon 26 Jun for the API lab look fine, but can we shift the start to 19:30 AEST on both days?
- Also, two asks: can you make sure logs ingestion steps are highlighted (we have unusual retention rules) and include a short bit on routing/fallback during the console?

I'll confirm with our infra lead, but tentatively confirm Thu 22 and Mon 26 at 19:30 AEST.

Thanks,
Alex
Head of Platform
Lytic Systems

Morning all,

I checked the sandbox access flow. For Lytic's account we need the following pre-reqs before Thu 22:

1) Application-level service account created in your staging project with the role `redwood-sandbox-user`
2) A single set of API keys (temp) that Ben can distribute during the lab — TTL 8 hours recommended
3) IP allowlist for our lab runners OR a temporary VPN token (your choice)

I've updated the mutual-action-plan with the checklist and put notes in column D about retention/logging. Marissa — I can pre-provision the temp keys if Alex's infra team gives me the service account email.

Priyom
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Nightshift-friendly hybrid console + API onboarding — split or single session?

Hi Alex — thanks for the preference. 19:30 AEST on Thu 22 and Mon 26 works for me. A couple of logistical items for the API lab:

- I'll share a small Colab + Postman collection ahead of the session (will drop in the shared Drive link). Please ask your engineers to have Python 3.10 and the requests library installed.
- For the logs ingestion demo, I’ll prepare a short runbook showing how to configure the retention policy and a fallback route to a lower-cost model variant.

I’ll drop the colab link by EOD Wednesday and the Postman collection by Friday. Looking forward to it.

Ben
Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference

All good — Thu 22 Jun 19:30 AEST (console) and Mon 26 Jun 19:30 AEST (API lab) confirmed from our side. Priyom, I'll send the service account email to you this afternoon.

Two quick follow-ups: can you also provide a short recording of the console tour after the Thu session for our colleagues who can't attend live? And can you confirm whether the API keys you provision will be scoped to staging only (preferred)?

Thanks again — excited to get started.

Alex
